components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 42px; padding: 9px 18px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a4174 0%, #0d6db7 55%, #0ea5e9 100%); color: #ffffff; font-family: var(--font-sans, sans-serif); font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -4px rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.35); transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #08355e 0%, #0b5d9e 55%, #0284c7 100%); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0284c7; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 42px; padding: 9px 16px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #b8d0e4; background: #ffffff; color: #0a4174; font-family: var(--font-sans, sans-serif); font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #eaf3fb; border-color: #0ea5e9; color: #001d39; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0284c7; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: CubeSAT — PTIT LMS pairs bright, high-clarity daytime lab surfaces with deep aerospace navy anchors and dark-bay telemetry consoles. It serves university students programming physical CubeSat 1U kits over Web Serial alongside instructors managing class cohorts, prerequisites, and Lab Tests. Visual authority comes from technical precision, clear tabular telemetry, and unmistakable status wayfinding rather than decorative marketing chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Daylight-first academic surfaces tinted toward aerospace blue (#f4f9fd to #ffffff), never washed-out pure gray.
Deep Orbital Navy (#0a4174) and Deep Telemetry Bay (#071526) structural anchors for navigation, code, and serial logs.
Tabular numeric discipline (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) across timers, telemetry readouts, scores, and lab progress.
Full-perimeter 1px semantic borders on cards and notices—never thick left/right accent stripes.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Never use pure untinted grays (#64748b, #e2e8f0) on aerospace-tinted cards; all neutrals carry a cool navy undertone so text and borders belong to the same light source.

rules.name: The Text-Link Contrast Rule
rules.body: Never use #0ea5e9 for body-sized text on light backgrounds (2.77:1); always use --text-link (#0369a1, 5.93:1) or --cubesat-navy (#0a4174, 10.3:1).

rules.name: The Tabular Telemetry Rule
rules.body: Every live counter, countdown clock, sensor reading, percentage, and lab index badge must declare font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so digits never jitter during updates.

rules.name: The Perimeter Border Rule
rules.body: Every card, callout, and status banner uses a uniform 1px solid perimeter border paired with a subtle background tint—never a thick 3px or 4px border-left stripe.

dos: Do keep all user-facing UI labels, buttons, empty states, and error messages in clear, natural Vietnamese while keeping code identifiers and telemetry keys in English.
Do use semantic status tokens (--status-info-*, --status-success-*, --status-warning-*, --status-danger-*, --status-neutral-*) for badges, banners, and telemetry indicators.
Do maintain a minimum 42px–44px touch/click target on interactive controls used in classroom labs.
donts: Don't add thick border-left or border-right accent bars (> 1px) to cards, callouts, quiz explanations, or notices.
Don't use bounce or spring overshoot curves (cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)); use --ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)).
Don't use English uppercase decorative kickers (USER ACCESS, ADMIN ACCESS, TELEMETRY FEED) above Vietnamese headings.
